dct_description_sm: This project tested existing formulations and new formulations of trinexepac-ethyl for the market of turfgrass growth regulation. The primary objective of the study was to determine if the formulations being tested in the trial provided similar performance in terms of their efficacy for regulating growth of both fairway and greens height turf. Performance was measured by how the treatments impacted turfgrass growth (clipping production), turfgrass phytotoxicity, and associated quality measures. The studies have provided information to the sponsor for purposes of registering new formulations of growth regulators for the Canadian market.
dct_title_s: Replication data for: Evaluating new and existing formulants of trinexapac-ethyl on a golf green and fairway in Guelph, Ontario -  A field study
